content:
kelly-peopleops: Quick update 3 3 were publishing plain-language clarifications to PTO examples, parental leave timelines, and expense receipt guidance. Editorial only 3 no changes to eligibility or accruals. Managers: please finish the 15m micro-module and confirm via the manager ack CSV by 2026-11-15. Details + diff: https://internal.redwood/handbook/nov-clarity :sparkles:

omar-hr: Uploaded a one-page highlights PDF and manager FAQ to /shared/hr/handbook_nov_clarity/highlights.pdf. Please flag anything that looks like a substantive change.

tim-engmgr: Does this affect contractor reimbursements? We get a lot of screenshots from vendors.

kelly-peopleops: No change to reimbursement eligibility. We clarified acceptable receipt formats: PDF, vendor email invoice, or screenshot that includes vendor, date, and total. Screenshots must show vendor+date.

rachel-ic: My manager mapping didn't sync. Can managers be added manually?

omar-hr: Yes 3 send a CSV (name,email,team) to hr-ops@redwood and well merge before export.

ack-bot: Reminder scheduled 3 3-day and 1-day nudges. Training: https://training.redwood/handbook-nov (15m).

tim-engmgr: Any canned text for team channels? Want to paste into our standup note.

kelly-peopleops: Use: "FYI: clarified handbook wording on PTO and expenses (no policy changes). Managers: complete 15m training by Nov 15 and confirm via the ack CSV: <training link>. Q&A drop-in Thu 10am PT."

rachel-ic: Completed the micro-module 44d

omar-hr: For infra: export command for manager list:
```
./tools/hr_export --format=csv --cols=name,email,team --filter=managers > managers_nov2026.csv
```

kelly-peopleops: Thanks all 3 final ack tracker will be posted to /shared/hr/ack_nov2026.csv after the audit. If anything reads like a policy change, call it out here immediately.
